# C³ Executive Suite

> C³ Executive Suite (c3execs.com, also written C3 Executive Suite) is an executive leadership firm. It provides hands-on interim and fractional C-suite executives who take direct responsibility for a business function during transition, growth, financial distress, restructuring, or a leadership vacancy. Not affiliated with C3.ai or other companies named C3.

## Practices
- Executive Leadership: interim and fractional C-suite leadership across finance, operations, strategy, growth, transformation, people, and governance.
- Financial Services: CFO advisory, controllership, financial reporting, transaction support, and a complete accounting function including bookkeeping.

## Who we serve
Owner-led, founder-led, and private equity-backed companies, generally in the [5M-50M USD] revenue range; larger companies have also been served. Buyers and referral sources include business owners, CEOs, PE sponsors, portfolio company leadership, investors, lenders, M&A advisors, and professional service firms.

## Partners
- Mark Fackrell: Finance, Operations & Transactions. 25+ years in financial recovery, interim executive leadership, private equity, M&A, restructuring, and operations.
- Eric Hughes: Growth, Strategy & Technology Transformation.
- Ravi VC: Strategy, Execution Risk & Commercial Systems.

## Representative engagement
Interim accounting and controllership leadership at a PE-owned global professional services firm. The company had 18 months of unclosed books; the annual audit was completed in approximately 10 weeks.
